import ast,inspect
for mod in ('more','recipes'):
  src=ast.parse(open(f'more_itertools/{mod}.pyi').read())
  stub={n.name:[a.arg for a in n.args.posonlyargs+n.args.args+n.args.kwonlyargs] for n in ast.walk(src) if isinstance(n,(ast.FunctionDef))}
  m=getattr(B,mod)
  names=set(m.__all__)
  for nm in sorted(names):
    if nm not in stub and not any(isinstance(n,ast.ClassDef) and n.name==nm for n in ast.walk(src)): print('missing stub',mod,nm); continue

      if real!=stub[nm]: print('sig mismatch',nm,real,stub[nm])
"
